title: Why the same SIP date every month

scenes.text: Why does Papa pick the same date every month?

scenes.speaker: Beta
scenes.text: Papa, why the same SIP date every month?

scenes.speaker: Papa
scenes.text: Because a habit works better than a mood, beta.

scenes.speaker: Beta
scenes.text: And if the news looks scary that week?

scenes.speaker: Papa
scenes.text: Then we read our plan first, not the headlines.

scenes.label: Remember
scenes.text: A fixed date turns investing from a decision into a routine.
